targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time, endpoint, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p50_ms, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95_ms FROM transit.usage_events WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status >= 400) AS errors, count(*) AS total FROM transit.usage_events WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', started_at) AS time, adapter || ':' || status AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM transit.sync_runs WHERE started_at > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT created_at, agency_id, error FROM transit.feed_quarantine WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT k.label, k.quota_daily, count(u.id) AS used_today, k.quota_daily - count(u.id) AS remaining FROM transit.api_keys k LEFT JOIN transit.usage_events u ON u.api_key_id = k.id AND u.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) WHERE k.revoked_at IS NULL AND k.quota_daily > 0 GROUP BY k.id, k.label, k.quota_daily ORDER BY remaining ASC
